chips.name: Night Vision
chips.description: During night battles, the echelon gains an extra node of vision range.

chips.name: Night Vision
chips.description: During night battles, offsets 100% of night battle accuracy penalties.

chips.name: Phantom Stance
chips.description: The echelon does not expend any action point for their first move each round.

chips.name: Ample Fuel
chips.description: The echelon may bring an additional 2 pips of ammo and rations.

chips.name: Frugal Mobilization
chips.description: The echelon does not consume any ammo or rations and receives a 15% damage buff in the first battle after deployment.

chips.name: Pilfer
chips.description: Possibility to obtain a drop from enemies on the adjacent node. Pilfered enemies cannot be pilfered again.

chips.name: Quick Resupply
chips.description: Calls in a supply paradrop for a neighboring echelon.

chips.name: Weaken
chips.description: Reduces the damage of enemy echelons within 2 nodes by 12%.

chips.name: Fighting Spirit
chips.description: Increases the damage of friendly echelons within 3 nodes by 6%.

chips.name: Lone Wolf
chips.description: Increases the echelon's damage by 10% when there are no allies within 1 node.

chips.name: Defend
chips.description: When on a friendly-controlled node, increase echelon evasion by 100% and armor by 50%.

chips.name: Strength in Numbers
chips.description: The more units there are in the echelon, the higher the echelon-wide damage buff - capped at 15%.

chips.name: Support
chips.description: Increase damage of friendly reinforcement units within 2 nodes by 20%. The damage buff does not stack.

units.name: Scarecrow
units.introduce: A Sangvis specialized in gathering and analyzing intelligence. She isn't the best in direct confrontations, which earns her little respect among Sangvis Dolls. Rational, curt, and dutiful, she despises sentimentality and looks down on emotional Griffin Dolls who blindly follow their orders.

skills.name: Battlefield Purge
skills.description: Passive: Scarecrow's normal attacks consist of a volley from her three floating guns, with each floating gun shot dealing 40% of Scarecrow's damage. Active: Scarecrow greatly increases the performance of her attack modules, causing her floating guns to spin rapidly for 5 seconds and deal 10 rounds of damage, while also increasing the damage of each floating gun shot by #1, targeting the unit with the lowest current HP.

skills.name: Shadow Predation
skills.description: Places a scout unit on a node within 1 space that you can reach. This unit cannot move, but it can capture nodes, and leaves the battlefield after 1 turn. When it encounters an enemy unit, it is destroyed and does damage equal to #1 of its max HP to the enemy.

skills.name: Curse
skills.description: Every #1 volleys, Scarecrow's last shot lowers the target unit's evasion by #2 and their rate of fire by #3 for #4 seconds.

skills.name: Ghost Step
skills.description: When on an enemy-controlled node, raise the echelon's damage by #1.

units.name: Executioner
units.introduce: An elite scout who often partners with Scarecrow but is slightly higher in rank. A rough-mannered and impulsive tomboy who takes delight in fair fights and dislikes bullying the weak.

skills.name: Hybrid Attack
skills.description: Slash the enemy unit with the highest HP, inflicting 3 instances of damage to all enemies within a radius of 1 around the target for a total of #1 melee damage. This damage is evenly distributed over each dummy link of the target. Also deal #2 damage to all enemies in a radius of 4 and gain a #3-point shield that lasts for #4 seconds.

skills.name: Execution Requiem
skills.description:
Press skill to switch between different attack modes. Switching modes raises self move speed by 100% for 3 seconds.
Misty Rose(default): Deal 1x damage to the closest target, and apply #1 vulnerability every 3 attacks.
 Clear Sky Empress: Switch to melee attack mode and decrease attack range by 3. Attacks automatically inflict critical hits and ROF decreases by #2 while dealing #3 melee damage to all enemies within a radius of 4.
 The first time you switch between modes, raise all melee units' movement speed by 50% and grant all melee units in front of Executioner a 5-point shield that lasts for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Blazing
skills.description: When switching to melee mode, raise self evasion by #1 and gain a #2-point shield that lasts for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Shatterfrost
skills.description: Deal increasing damage as the enemy's HP decreases, to a maximum of #1.

units.name: Hunter
units.introduce: Highly flexible and intelligent, she is adept at sabotage and tactical pursuit, though her true power can only manifest when working with Scarecrow and Executioner. Stoic and cool-headed, she enjoys cornering her enemies and capturing them alive. Despite feeling superior to Griffin Dolls, she considers herself above using underhanded tactics against them.

skills.name: Exterminating Blood Shot
skills.description: Passive: Hunter makes auto-attacks with both guns, dealing 2 instances of 0.5x damage to her target. Active: For #1 seconds, she attacks the enemy unit with the highest HP, dealing #2 damage per shot. While the skill is active, each consecutive hit does an additional #3 damage over the previous one, stacking up to 15 times. If there are any targets present who are being affected by Binding Shot, she prioritizes them instead.

skills.name: Beast-Caging Snipe
skills.description: Hunter gains a special Binding Shot every #1 seconds, with a maximum capacity of 3 shots. Tapping the skill icon fires them, dealing 100% guaranteed damage to the enemy unit with the highest current HP, as well as immobilizing them and applying a taunt status to them for #2 seconds. At the same time, their accuracy is reduced by #3 and their armor is reduced by #4 for #5 seconds. This can stack once.

skills.name: Fury
skills.description: Every attack that does not inflict a critical hit raises the damage of the next critical hit by #1.

skills.name: Plague Edge
skills.description: If Hunter's current target is suffering from debuffs, Hunter does an additional #1 damage to them.

units.name: Intruder
units.introduce: In charge of providing battle strategies, yet also adept at decryption and sabotage. Relatively high in rank, she can directly issue commands to combat Dolls but answers to Gager. Her apparent poise and soft-spokenness mask a gaping sense of emptiness. She enjoys human theater and hopes to derive her own personality from it.

skills.name: Military Raid
skills.description: Summon 3 Dinergate reinforcements, who ram and damage enemies in their way. Each pack of Dinergates consists of 3 squads of 5-linked Dinergates who have 5% of Intruder's max health, 100% of her damage, 50% of her accuracy and 50% of her evasion. Each individual Dinergate link does #1 damage to enemies they hit.

skills.name: Indomitable Reinforcements
skills.description: Select one echelon as the target for this skill. Target echelon is reinforced by a group of Dinergates at the beginning of battle. Each group of Dinergates is composed of 2 5x-linked packs of Dinergates which have #1 HP, #2 DMG, 50 ROF, 50 ACC and 70 EVA.

skills.name: All-Round Defense
skills.description: At the start of the battle, grant all friendly units a shield with a value of #1 of Intruder's health for #2 seconds.

skills.name: Strengthened Reinforcements
skills.description: When Intruder is on the field, all friendly reinforcements gain a shield with a value of #1 of Intruder's HP, as well as a damage boost of #2 of Intruder's damage.

units.name: Destroyer
units.introduce: An expert in blowing things up and disarming bombs who also possesses decent combat abilities. Occasionally teams up with Alchemist. She's usually haughty and sharp-tongued, but is actually a tsundere with a somewhat childish temper. She cries under pressure and is very sensitive about her height.

skills.name: Wind-Grasping Hand
skills.description: Lock onto the enemy unit with the highest HP and deals #1 damage to all unit Dummy Links within a cross-shaped area around it and ignores armor.

skills.name: Composite Grenade
skills.description: Destroyer's normal attacks use special grenade launchers that require reloading for 2 seconds after every 12 shots. In exchange for reducing her attack speed by #1, every round of attacks fires 2 grenades which deal 0.5x explosive damage that scales with Dummy-Links to all enemy units in a 1-unit radius.

skills.name: Inferno Reload
skills.description: The first shot after each reload does #1 damage and ignites the ground, dealing #2 damage for 0.5 seconds while also inflicting #3 vulnerability on enemy units within the radius for 2.5 seconds.

units.name: Architect
units.introduce: A loner with high combat prowess that specializes in long-range attacks and fire support. A cheerful and energetic airhead of a girl who's always in high spirits. She isn't particularly antagonistic towards Griffin and doesn't always go out of her way to follow orders from Sangvis Ferri. However, her passion for bombardment and destruction still makes her a highly dangerous enemy.

skills.name: Carnival Activation
skills.description: Deal #1 guaranteed link-ignoring damage to the enemy unit with the highest HP, then inflicts #2 explosive damage to all enemy units within a 4 radius of the target.

skills.name: Explosion
skills.description: Every normal attack by this unit inflicts 4 instances of 0.25x damage. Every 6 normal attacks deals an additional #1 explosive damage that scales with Dummy-Links to all enemy units within a 1-unit radius.

skills.name: Penetration
skills.description: When this unit is on the field, all friendly explosive damage is increased by #1.

units.name: Ouroboros
units.introduce: An intelligent Doll created after the Butterfly Incident with high combat capabilities, specializing in short-range assaults and defensive battles. But as the test subject in the developmental phase, her AI is very unstable and difficult to control. Possessing an overwhelming tactical and intellectual advantage over others, she is very self-assured and conceited, but she has little actual combat experience and is too unpredictable even for her allies, which makes her highly dangerous.

skills.name: Venomous Blossom
skills.description: Every 1 seconds, inflict #1 damage (can score critical hits) on a random enemy unit's Dummy Links, for a total of 8 instances of damage.

skills.name: Mobius
skills.description:
Passive: When standing on a friendly-controlled node, increase all friendly units' rate of fire by #1 and their move speed by 3. During night battles, this effect takes place on any node.
 Active: Can be used on any enemy unit within a #2-node radius, immobilizing them for 1 turn.

skills.name: Venomous Fang
skills.description: Ouroboros' normal attacks inflict two instances of 0.5x damage. Whenever she scores a critical hit on a target, said target is afflicted with #1 vulnerability for #2 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

skills.name: Stimulatory Hormone
skills.description: Increase all friendly units' critical hit chance by #1 for #2 seconds.

units.name: Alchemist
units.introduce: A Sangvis elite who specializes in all kinds of tactics and interrogations. Occasionally teams up with Destroyer. Arrogant, brash, and ruthless, she will do anything to achieve her goals. She has a sadistic streak and toys with Griffin Dolls to satisfy her perverse tendencies. However, her mental maturity still compels her to go the extra mile for her Sangvis companions.

skills.name: Terminus
skills.description: Passive: When in Defense Mode, Alchemist gains extra attack range and her regular attacks consist of two volleys that deal 0.5x damage. When not in Defense Mode, she gains 50% critical chance and her attacks inflict two instances of 0.5x melee damage that cannot miss. Active: After activating the skill, perform 9 attacks on random enemy units. Each attack inflicts two instances of #1 guaranteed damage that can score critical hits and marks them with "Organism". Alchemist is invincible while the skill is being performed.

skills.name: Quantitative Activation
skills.description:
Passive: Critical hits inflict the "Organism" mark.
Active: Increase self damage by #1, evasion by #2 and critical damage by #3 for #4 seconds.

skills.name: Organism
skills.description: At all times, attacking targets with the "Organism" mark makes them take #1 damage, while granting Alchemist a #2-point shield for #3 seconds, which stacks without limit. The "Organism" mark persists for #4 seconds.

skills.name: Gravity Unravel
skills.description:
When not in Defense Mode, raise all friendly units' move speed by #1 every 6 seconds. The buff lasts for 3 seconds and diminishes rapidly.
When in Defense Mode, gain a shield with a value equal to #2 of max HP every 1 seconds, lasting for #3 seconds.

units.name: Dreamer
units.introduce: Combat-oriented and possesses ultra long-range pinpoint sniping capability. A Doll created after the Buttlerfly Incident who answers directly to Elisa. Since she isn't designed to engage enemies directly, she spends most of her time hanging around Sangvis Ferri HQ and bullying Judge for her own amusement. Her charming smile is a flimsy disguise for her arrogance and capriciousness. She is extremely mentally unstable and egotistical, and is prone to becoming frenzied and losing control in battle. She has formidable destructive power and will often disregard her allies' safety. Fortunately, she rarely ever appears in direct combat.

skills.name: Nirvanic Demolition
skills.description:
Passive: Dreamer prioritizes the most distant target from herself. 
Active: Attack the closest target with a piercing beam. The beam is active for 3 seconds and inflicts #1 instances of #2 guaranteed damage that ignores armor and scales with Dummy-Links.

skills.name: Hawkeye Protection
skills.description: When in Defense Mode, increase effective attack range to 16 while also raising critical chance by #1 and critical damage by #2. Every attack deals guaranteed damage. When not in Defense Mode, all friendly ranged units gain #3 damage and #4 rate of fire, while friendly melee units gain #5 damage intake reduction.

skills.name: Master of the Sky
skills.description: Dreamer deals more damage the further away her target is from her. She starts gaining damage bonuses at the range of 5, to a maximum of a #1 multiplier at the range of 12.

units.name: Gager
units.introduce: Mostly in charge of issuing commands and deploying units. Relatively high in rank, she is in command of combat units, yet is quite adept at combat herself. Answers directly to Agent. Serious, uptight, and meticulous, she always appears cool and businesslike both in speech and action. She holds herself to a code of honor even against her enemies.

skills.name: Lunar Return
skills.description: Perform two charges at the 3 enemy units with the highest HP. The first charge does #1 guaranteed damage that ignores armor but cannot score critical hits, as well as inflicting 1 stacks of Weight on the enemy. The second charge deals #2 guaranteed damage that ignores armor but cannot score critical hits, then detonates all stacks of Weight on every enemy unit in a 2-unit radius around the target. Every 1 stacks of Weight inflicts 2 instances of guaranteed #3 explosive damage that ignores shields and armor, but cannot score critical hits.

skills.name: Overall Calibration
skills.description:
Passive: Each of Gager's regular attacks does 2 instances of 0.6x damage, with a 30% chance of applying 1 stacks of Weight to the target.
Active: Gager increases her rate of fire to maximum and reduces her evasion and accuracy by #1 and #2 respectively for #3 seconds. During this time, she prioritizes enemies which have not been attacked yet, and all damage she inflicts for the duration applies stacks of Weight.

skills.name: Weight
skills.description: Every stack of Weight reduces the target's move speed by #1, damage by #2 and armor by #3, lasting for #4 seconds. The maximum stack size of Weight is 3.

skills.name: Trial By Combat
skills.description: 3 seconds after the start of battle, increase the damage of all friendly units by #1 as long as the number of friendly units on the battlefield does not exceed the number of enemy units on the battlefield.

units.name: Judge
units.introduce: Command-oriented and responsible for Sangvis Ferri HQ's defense and security systems. She is essentially Elisa's bodyguard and only obeys Elisa's personal orders. A Doll created after the Butterfly Incident. Having to deal with Dreamer's antics every day gives her a headache. Stern and old-fashioned, she possesses a soldier's dignity and bearing. She is absolutely loyal to Elisa, but her short stature doesn't make her very imposing to most people. Anyone who points that out will suffer terribly, friend or foe.

skills.name: Verdict
skills.description: Launch a flying kick against the enemy unit with the highest HP, dealing #1 damage spread across 4 instances to enemies in a radius of 1 units. This damage ignores armor, scales with Dummy-Links, but cannot crit. The attack also induces a debuff to targets within a 4-unit radius, decreasing their firepower by #2 and rate of fire by #3, while giving them #4 vulnerability, lasting for #5 seconds. The skill then activates a shield with taunt effect and an independent health bar that is #6 of Judge's maximum HP, lasting for #7 seconds. All damage dealt to the shield will be fixed at 1.

skills.name: Individual Adjustment
skills.description: Target any echelon within a radius of 1, granting all units in the echelon a #1-point shield at the beginning of the battle. Units with armor receive a #2 increase in armor while other units receive a #3 increase in evasion. All shields and buffs last for #4 seconds.

skills.name: Law and Order
skills.description: The normal attack of this unit hits two enemies, dealing 0.5x damage to each target. After every 8 normal attacks, deal damage that is #1 the current armor value to enemies within a 3-unit distance. This damage ignores armor, scales with Dummy-Links, but does not crit. Also gain a #2-point shield, lasting for #3 seconds.

skills.name: Dogma
skills.description: When Judge is present, increase the armor of T-Dolls in the frontmost row by #1 points, the accuracy of T-Dolls in the middle row by #2 points, and the firepower of T-Dolls in the back row by #3.

units.name: Agent
units.introduce: In charge of liaising between Elisa and her Sangvis subordinates as well as logistics management. As a high-ranking unit adept at both combat and tactics, she's able to command all Dolls in combat, and they all directly answer to her. Calm and composed, she always speaks in a courteous tone to friends and foes alike. However, apart from the genuine respect she has for her master, she holds everyone else in low regard, especially Griffin.

skills.name: Bloody Gleam
skills.description: Create 3 decoy Dummies on a special position on the front row. The decoys inherit Agent's passive skills and also 10% of her max HP, #1 of her damage, #2 of her rate of fire, #3 of her accuracy, 20% of her evasion, and they possess 10 points of armor. All other stats are the same as Agent's. They exist for a maximum duration of #4 seconds.

skills.name: Hapless Assault
skills.description:
Active: This echelon can move to any Heliport on the map. For the next two turns, it will take a 60% penalty to damage, accuracy, evasion and armor.
Passive: When Agent is supported by HOC and Coalition units, all friendly Dolls gain 15% crit rate and all ranged units gain 1 range upon engaging enemies in battle.

skills.name: Heedless
skills.description: A regular attack from this character consists of a volley of shooting from 4 machine guns. Each burst of machine gun fire results in 0.25x damage. Every 5 volleys of shooting inflicts stun for 1 seconds on the target, as well as #1 vulnerability for #2 seconds.

skills.name: Punishment
skills.description: Whenever any unit or reinforcement unit dies, increase self damage by #1 for #2 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

units.name: Adeline
units.introduce: One of Paradeus' Nytos. Wielding a highly destructive rifle, she dances among explosions and crashes through her enemies like an angry wave. As a mass-produced model, she has the habit of suppressing her emotions. It is impossible to tell if there are human sentiments lurking beneath her cold and unfathomable facade.

skills.name: Silent Epitaph
skills.description:
Passive: Damage dealt by Adeline is evenly distributed among each of her target's Dummies. If an enemy has a Black Mark and a White Mark on them, Adeline's attack detonates them, removing them and dealing #1 guaranteed explosive damage that ignores armor.
Active: For #2 seconds, Black Marks on the enemy will not be removed by detonation and all enemy units have their accuracy and evasion reduced by #3. While this skill is in effect, prioritize enemy units with no Dummies. After 1 seconds of aiming, deal #4 guaranteed damage that is reduced by armor and can score critical hits.

skills.name: Quietus
skills.description: If Adeline misses an attack, she applies a Black Mark to her target and increases self damage by #1 for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Pronouncement of Death
skills.description: When on the field, Adeline does #1 extra damage to targets that bear Black or White Marks.

units.name: Alina
units.introduce: One of Paradeus' Nytos. She descends upon the battlefield like a pure white angel of death, cutting through steel and harvesting lives with her scythe. She takes pride in being one of the earliest advanced Nytos and only shows her cute and gentle side to those she deems worthy.

skills.name: White Night Advent
skills.description:
Passive: Damage dealt by Alina is evenly distributed among the target's Dummy-Links. When an enemy unit has a Black Mark and a White Mark on them at the same time and Alina is on the battlefield, she detonates the marks (clearing them both) and deals #1 guaranteed explosive damage that ignores armor.
Active: For the next #2 seconds, her normal attack is enhanced into a three-part attack, the first two of which inflict melee damage to a single unit, while the third part deals melee damage in a radius of 3, while also triggering Rest In Peace. Every attack applies a permanent White Mark to the target. The damage multipliers for each part of her attack are #3, #4 and #5.

skills.name: Rest In Peace
skills.description: Every attack has a 20% chance to trigger Rest In Peace: Increase the damage of allies within a 2-unit radius (does not include summons) by #1 and protect them from damage, lasting for 1 seconds.

skills.name: Pronouncement of Death
skills.description: When Alina is on the field, all units deal #1 increased damage to all enemies with Black or White Marks.

units.name: Architect - NVW Model
units.introduce: Architect - Naval Warfare Specialized Model, NVW Model for short, is a naval warfare Doll body that IOP created by breaking down and making modifications to an abandoned Sangvis project. When not on the seaside, Architect will alter her surroundings into a naval environment with stored materials before entering combat. Constructing suitable battle fronts is an architect's job, after all.

skills.name: Water Bomb Skirmish
skills.description: Deal #1 guaranteed explosive damage that scales with Dummy-Links and ignores armor to the nearest target and other enemy units within a radius of 3 behind the target, dazing them for 2 seconds.

skills.name: Barrage Heatwave
skills.description:
Press skill to switch between different weapon modes.
 Machine Gun Mode (default): With each attack, gain a buff that increases rate of fire and critical rate by #1 and #2 respectively for 5 seconds, stacking up to 10 times.
 Shark Cannon Mode: Reduce rate of fire by #3, each attack launches a Shark Grenade that deals #4 explosive damage to the target and enemy units within a radius of 2.

skills.name: Into the Sea
skills.description: At the start of the battle, change the backdrop to the summer seaside and summon waves to knock back enemies every #1 seconds, reducing their move speed by #2 for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Penetration
skills.description: When this unit is on the field, all friendly explosive damage is increased by #1.

units.name: Intruder - Sorceress of the End
units.introduce: Intruder - Sorceress of the End is a Doll body specializing in military encounters that IOP created from simulation data gathered by extensive analysis and experimentation on Intruder. With new technology applied to her emotion module, not only does the Sorceress of the End model possess immense command and support capabilities, she can also instill crippling fear in her enemies' minds on a small battlefield, effectively destroying their morale.

skills.name: Creeping Mist
skills.description:
Enshroud the enemy echelon in a ghostly mist, reducing enemy units' accuracy by #1 and inflicting 10% vulnerability. Enemy units take #2 damage that scales with Dummy-Links every second. The ghostly mist lasts 6 seconds.
 Summon 2 groups of Halloween Dinergates with a full complement of Dummies. Each Dinergate has HP that equals 5% of the Sorceress' maximum HP, 10% of her damage, and 100% of her accuracy, evasion and rate of fire. The Dinergates last for 10 seconds.
 Halloween Dinergate: After every 6 normal attacks, gain 1 extra Dummy that inherits 100% of the unit's stats , lasting for 10 seconds.

skills.name: Parade of the Spirits
skills.description:
Summon a group of Halloween Prowler SWAPs with a full complement of Dummies and the following stats: HP: 200, damage: 30, rate of fire: 80, accuracy: 70, evasion: 80, lasting for 15 seconds.
 Halloween Prowler SWAP: Increase damage and evasion of all friendly melee units within a radius of 3 by 15% and 40% respectively. The buff does not stack.
 Halloween Prowler SWAPs' skill, "Protection Emphasis", is at level 5.
 When a summoned Halloween Prowler SWAP dies, increase attack speed of all friendly mechanical units by 15% for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Midnight Theater
skills.description: At the start of the battle, change the backdrop to the Halloween Theater. Sing an opera to grant the 2 friendly mechanical units with the highest base damage a damage increase that equals #1 of the Sorceress' own damage. During nighttime, increase night vision of all friendly units by #2.

skills.name: Jack's Blessings
skills.description: When the Sorceress is present, all friendly units gain a shield that equals #1 of her maximum HP at the start of the battle. Mechanical units also gain an additional rate of fire increase that equals #2 of the Sorceress' rate of fire.

units.name: Destroyer - Dashing Reindeer
units.introduce: Destroyer - Dashing Reindeer is a specialized model developed for combat in snow, ensuring that Destroyer can maintain her high speed and accuracy even in the cold. This model also features enhanced firepower and explosive strength. At Destroyer's own forceful insistence, the appearance is based on a reindeer, and her ammo is packaged as Christmas hanging ornaments, so that she can deliver sweet death to her enemies.

skills.name: Winter Trio
skills.description:
Lob Mode: Randomly fire 9 ice shells at a column within firing range. Each ice shell does #1 damage that scales with Dummy Links within a 1 radius and also applies 2 stacks of Chilling Mark when it does damage.
Impact Mode: Fire ice shells from both cannons at once, dealing one instance of damage that scales with Dummy Links to enemies in the three columns in front of self. This damage drops off with range: #2/#3/#4 damage that scales with Dummy Links, while also inflicting 4/2/1 stacks of Chilling Mark respectively.
Precision Mode: Lock onto the enemy with the highest HP and fire off 9 ice shells, each dealing #5 damage that does not scale with Dummy Links and applying 1 stacks of Chilling Mark. Once a target is no longer valid, she switches to a different one.

skills.name: Arctic Drive
skills.description:
Active: Clicking on the skill button toggles between Winter Trio's activation modes: Lob Mode(default),Impact Mode, and Precision Mode.
Passive: Destroyer - Fleeting Reindeer's skills use special ice shells which apply Chilling Markson hit.
Chilling Mark: Each stack of Chilling Mark decreases the target's ROF by #1 and their move speed by #2. This effect can stack and lasts for #3 seconds. Once the target has 6 stacks of Chilling Marks, they are all converted to 1 stacks of Frozen Marks, which freeze the target for #4 seconds.

skills.name: Composite Grenade
skills.description: Destroyer - Fleeting Reindeer uses special grenade launchers for her normal attacks, granting her 12 grenades and requiring 2 seconds to reload after they are expended. In exchange for reducing her attack speed by #1, every round of attacks fires 2 grenades which deal 0.5x damage that scales with Dummy-Links to all enemy units in a 1 radius.

skills.name: Reindeer's Hunting Grounds
skills.description: At the start of battle, change the backdrop to a wintry snowfield, inflicting #1 stacks of Chilling Marks to all enemy units each second. Destroyer - Fleeting Reindeer deals #2 additional damage to enemies with Frozen Marks.

units.name: Hunter - Nightfall Moth
units.introduce: Hunter - Nightfall Moth is a uniquely-specialized assassination model. Her clothing incorporates structures similar to those of insect wing scales, and the colors they reflect can be adjusted in order to blend into the environment. In keeping with Hunter's personal preferences, they default to a cornflower blue color under normal circumstances, which seems to exert a certain degree of hypnotic effect. In combat, this effect is primarily shown by filling the air with blue flower petals or by suddenly changing the background. This also implies that by the time you see the abovementioned scenery, you have already stepped into Hunter's trap.

skills.name: Lingering Bloodscent
skills.description:
Passive: Hunter - Nightfall Moth uses twin handguns for her regular attacks, prioritizing units with Rose Marks and doing 2 instances of 0.5x damage to them.
Active: Buffs self damage by #1 for each separate buff on herself, stacking up to 5 times, and each regular attack does 2 instances of #2 damage that is guaranteed to hit. #3 seconds duration.

skills.name: Soulbreaker Thorns
skills.description:
Passive: Hunter - Nightfall Moth's regular attacks pierce shields and do #1 additional damage to them.
Active: Increase self damage and critical chance by #2 and #3 respectively. Enemies with Rose Marks take #4 of their current HP in damage that automatically hits and ignores armor each second, for #5 seconds.

skills.name: Dreamland
skills.description: At the start of battle, change the battlefield backdrop to a night-time chapel. All single-linked non-boss units apart from herself gain a Rose Mark: Until the end of battle, damage and evasion decrease by #1 and #2 respectively.

skills.name: Maverick Killer
skills.description: Do more damage to the enemy the fewer links they have, up to a maximum of a #1 increase.

units.name: Cerberus
units.introduce: An ultra-upgraded version of the Sangvis Dinergate with a massive boost to both its size, armor, and firepower. It can even hold a neural cloud (an incomplete version), but due to its terrible cost-effectiveness, mass production is impossible. The tactical role it is meant to play is also rather unclear, even the development records are unaccounted for, so it rarely makes an appearance on the battlefield.

skills.name: Light of Extinction
skills.description:
Normal attacks are a round of shots from the twin guns, each dealing 50% damage.
Increase damage of other friendly mechanical units by #1 for 5 seconds and fire a laser straight ahead, stunning all enemy units caught within the beam for 2 seconds. Also fire 10 missiles at the enemy unit with the highest HP, dealing #2 guaranteed damage in total.
At full Analysis, the laser does an additional #3 damage that scales with Dummy-Links to all enemies within its width.

skills.name: Earthshaking Bombardment
skills.description:
Trigger a grenade barrage after every 12 normal attacks, launching 6 grenades with a 1.5-unit radius within an area of 9 by 6 units. Each grenade deals #1 damage that scales with Dummy-Links.
At the same time, the twin guns fire 18 times at the nearest enemy unit, dealing #2 damage per shot. When this skill is triggered, increase self armor by #3 points for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Heart of Steel
skills.description: Every 10 seconds, grant all friendly mechanical units a shield with a value of #1 of their max HP, lasting for 5 seconds. When the shield vanishes, the corresponding units gain #2 evasion for #3 seconds.

skills.name: Survival Instinct
skills.description: The lower Cerberus' HP, the less damage it takes. Every #1 of its max HP that it loses reduces damage taken by 1%.

units.name: Alina - Mosasaur Rider
units.introduce: Alina - Mosasaur Rider is a specialized model for naval battles. Metal limbs, which are heavy and unwieldy in water, are replaced with lighter and more powerful ones, and both her outfit and construction materials are designed for optimal performance in naval warfare. As per Alina's own suggestion, a sharper and more nimble scythe inspired by an ancient marine creature from the Cretaceous Period has been forged to upgrade her weapon. With her giant scythe howling like a majestic beast, the pure white Goddess of Death is about to dive into the ocean, rending the tie between body and soul, reaping lives submerged in seawater.

skills.name: Tideroar Slash
skills.description:
When the skill is activated, deal #1 damage that scales with Dummy-Links to all enemy units within a 3-unit radius while also applying a Tidal Mark to them. While the skill is in effect, normal attacks become slash attacks against the nearest units. Skill duration is 8 seconds.
Slash attacks against enemy units with Tidal Marks deal an additional instance of 0.7x guaranteed damage that can crit but does not scale with Dummy-Links. When the skill ends, randomly kill an enemy unit with a Tidal Mark whose health is below 20%. After killing an enemy unit in this way, stun all enemy units within a 2-unit radius for 1 seconds. Once the skill ends, all instances of Tidal Mark vanish.

skills.name: Tidal Mark
skills.description:
Reduce self damage taken by #1. When the skill is activated, pull a maximum of 3 distant enemy units at random forward while applying #2 vulnerability and taunt to them for 6 seconds.
While this skill is in effect, normal attacks or Tideroar Slashes have an additional effect: deal 1x damage that scales with Dummy-Links in a 1-unit radius behind enemy targets while also applying a Tidal Mark.

skills.name: Aquatic Abyss
skills.description: At the start of the battle, convert the background to a summer seaside and deploy a Salted Fish Decoy with 1 HP every 10 seconds. When a Salted Fish Decoy dies, rate of fire and critical rate of all friendly Doll units (including self) increase by #1 and #2 respectively for #3 seconds.

skills.name: Heartfelt Prayer
skills.description: Increase self damage and evasion by #1 points every second, to a maximum of 120 points.

units.name: Executioner - Blood Fiend Huntress
units.introduce: A specialized model for hunting and pursuit. At Executioner's own request, a large artificial limb that can transform into a scythe is incorporated into the design so that she can reap her enemies and wreak havoc effortlessly in battle. At the same time, her black clothing makes it easier to melt into the shadows as her weapon glints coldly behind her enemies' back. Have you seen the one who haunts your dreams? She emerges at night and stalks with death. She hunts down all madness that falls into nightmare.

skills.name: Ominous Cascade
skills.description:
Executioner - Blood Fiend Huntress leaps ahead, dealing #1 damage that does not scale with Dummy-Links to enemies within a 2-unit radius around the nearest target, but the damage is split equally across the targets' Dummy-Links. Then, Executioner slashes backwards, dealing #2 damage that scales with Dummy-Links to enemies in a 3-unit radius behind the target.
When the skill ends, gain 100% damage intake reduction, which decreases by 20% per second and is then transformed into a shield with a value that equals 1% of self maximum HP, until the buff wears off.

skills.name: Crimson Claw Marks
skills.description:
Defense Mode ON:
Active: Normal attacks prioritize new targets and will always hit for 3 seconds.
Passive: Normal attacks that damage humanoid enemy units inflict Bullet Wound Bleed on targets.
Bullet Wound Bleed: Gain #1 vulnerability and take #2 points of flat damage per second.
Defense Mode OFF:
Active: Normal attack damage dealt to all enemies along the line of fire behind the current target is converted to melee damage that scales with Dummy-Links for 3 seconds.
Passive: Normal attacks that damage humanoid enemy units inflict Slash Wound Bleed on targets.
Slash Wound Bleed: Gain #3 damage reduction and take #4 points of flat damage per second.
Wounds take 3 seconds to heal. When an enemy gets wounded again, healing countdown is reset for both wounds at the same time. When an enemy is suffering from both debuffs, flat damage caused by both types of Bleed increases #5.

skills.name: Interwoven Nightmare
skills.description:
At the start of battle, convert the background to a perilous ship deck.
Defense Mode ON: Increase damage and rate of fire by #1. When bonus attack range is in effect, fire at the nearest enemy unit, dealing 1x damage.
Defense Mode OFF: Deal #2 guaranteed melee damage that does not scale with Dummy-Links to the nearest enemy and all units along the line of fire behind the target. Also grant a stack of shield to allies within a 2-unit radius per wave of normal attacks. Each shield has #3 of self evasion, stacking up to 3 times.

skills.name: Night Reaper
skills.description: Enemy units that have not taken any normal attack damage in 3 seconds now take #1 more damage from Executioner - Blood Fiend Huntress' normal attacks.

units.name: Tareus
units.introduce: Tareus, a specialized Nyto mech pilot, has an extremely high compatibility and synchronization rate with the mech "Miss Eve". She is also adept at hacking Dolls' neural clouds and unleashing devastating attacks on her targets. Since she has undergone numerous memory wipes and modifications, her virtual cognition image is very fragile and prone to severe mood swings, but her occasional emotional outbursts are always quickly neutralized by her internal programming.

skills.name: Charged Force Field
skills.description:
Prioritize the boss of enemy unit with the highest threat, dealing three-part #1 guaranteed single-target damage that ignores armor, and an instance of #2 splash damage that scales with Dummy-Links to enemies within a 4-unit radius around the target.
Deploy a 1000-point energy-absorbing shield with taunt effect in front of allies on the front row for 5 seconds. After the shield disappears, Tareus enters High-Power Mode for #3 seconds.
High-Power Mode:
Shots fired from her railgun are enhanced with piercing damage.
Charging time of her particle cannon is reduced to 3 seconds.
The one-shot threshold of her sniper rifle is increased to 25% of enemy HP.

skills.name: Rotary Trigger
skills.description:
Tareus attacks with three weapons:
Railgun: Deal #1 normal attack damage to the farthest enemy within range.
Particle Cannon: Charge for 4 seconds, then target the farthest unit within range and deal #2 damage that scales with Dummy-Links with a 2-unit radius.
Sniper Rifle: When a non-boss enemy unit with no Dummy-Links falls below 10%, kill them with a one-shot, with a 5-second cooldown after each shot.

skills.name: Phase Revolution
skills.description:
At the start of the battle, change the background to a neural cloud map and inflict the enemy unit with the highest threat with Spread Corrosion.
Spead Corrosion:
Spread to units within a 2.5-unit radius every 3 seconds or when an infected unit dies.
Inflict #1 vulnerability to infected units and reduce their accuracy by 5% for #2 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.

units.name: Scarecrow - Demonic Abyss
units.introduce: Scarecrow - Demonic Abyss is a new model with enhanced firepower. With new upgrades, Scarecrow's hovering guns are capable of more powerful damage output. The command ports on her fingertips are also enhanced, strengthening the connection between Scarecrow and the hovering guns. The inspiration for her outfit is apparently a certain mythical beast that would wreak havoc in human villages at the end of each year. Its ferocious eyes would glow in the dark, and its sharp claws could tear through anything... just like Scarecrow.

skills.name: Rotating Assault
skills.description:
Passive: Each normal attack by Scarecrow – Demonic Abyss consists of a complete rotation of her three hovering guns, with each shot dealing 40% damage and prioritizing high-threat enemies.
Active: The hover guns rotate rapidly for 2 seconds, then emit a piercing particle beam from the center of rotation.
Allies along the line of fire gain a shield with #1 of their own single-Dummy HP for 5 seconds. Enemies along the line of fire take #2 damage that scales with Dummy-Links and are paralyzed (cannot move or attack) for 2 seconds.

skills.name: Broken Wings
skills.description: Increase critical rate by #1. Hover guns attack enemy units at random for #2 seconds; each shot deals #3 damage, reduces the target's evasion by #4, and roots them in place. This effect lasts for #5 seconds and does not stack.

skills.name: Blood Rain Baptism
skills.description: After every #1 seconds, clear all stat buffs and shields on enemy units.

skills.name: Blade Dance
skills.description: When entering battle on a node occupied by the enemy, the echelon takes #1 less damage.

units.name: Sana
units.introduce: Sana is a specialized Doll for piloting mechs. With specific training and modifications, piloting mechs does not put any strain on her body, and she can pilot one in a fight for an extended period of time. Defenses, no matter how robust, will eventually crumble against her extremely powerful firepower and incredible durability. Unlike other Paradeus units, Sana inherits all her memories from a human girl named "Sana". However, while she is expected to become "Sana", the memories feel foreign to her, and her psyche wants to reject them. Perhaps she is secretly looking forward to the day when she can tear off the mask and become herself...

skills.name: Pyrotechnics
skills.description:
Passive: At the start of battle, the nearest 2 units are considered marked targets. When friendly units move, the 4 units around them are also considered additional marked units. Deal #1 more damage to marked units.
Active: Fire all missiles and deal #2 damage that scales with Dummy-Links and can crit to all enemies within the area of effect.

skills.name: Ebon Dirge
skills.description:
Charge for 1 seconds and fire a laser that prioritizes enemies with the highest armor, dealing #1 guaranteed damage that ignores armor and reduces armor by #2 points for #3 seconds.
If the target is a marked unit, additionally remove all shields and apply the same effect to all enemy units within detection range.

skills.name: Certain Misfortune
skills.description:
Every #1 rounds of normal attacks, the next normal attack will turn the nearest enemy unit which is not a marked unit into a marked unit.
Meanwhile, launch a smoke grenade with a 1.5-square radius at the furthest two enemy units. Non-boss units within the radius of the smoke grenades have their rate of fire and accuracy reduced by #2 for 3 seconds. Smoke grenade effects do not stack.

skills.name: Settled Verdict
skills.description: When a marked unit leaves the battlefield, increase self rate of fire by #1 for 20 seconds.

units.name: Narciss
units.introduce: Narciss, a Nyto specialized in combat, was a former Paradeus elite unit skilled in taking down enemies with her floating blades and close-quarter attacks. In order to maximize her combat efficiency, Paradeus built her body and weapons with both strength and speed in mind, while completely disregarding the high mental strain they caused. Prolonged exposure to extreme mental and physical torment had cost Narcissus her empathy, muddled her view of good, and eventually turned her into an outright implement of destruction. But now that said implement is separated from those who forced the will to kill upon her, her heart may one day find peace.

skills.name: Seven Original Sins
skills.description:
Passive: Narciss performs each attack with seven floating blades, each blade dealing 15% of Narciss' damage.
Active: Narciss dons her mask, then targets the furthest enemy unit and flits over to them in a flash, dealing #1 damage that scales with Dummy-Links. Repeat this assassination attack 3 times.

skills.name: Blood on the Blade
skills.description: Narciss disables her restrictions and deals 14 instances of #1 guaranteed damage to a random enemy unit with her floating blades while remaining stationery. Each hit applies #2 vulnerability to the target for #3 seconds.

skills.name: Lone Supremacy
skills.description: At the start of the battle, all units on both sides apart from self and allied T-Dolls deal #1 less damage.

skills.name: Stomp
skills.description: The lower an enemy unit's damage, the more damage she deals to the unit. Damage increase is capped at #1 and will only take effect on units whose damage is lower than 100.

units.name: Dreamer - Moonlit Sentinel
units.introduce: Dreamer - Moonlit Sentinel is a specialized model developed for fighting in the dark. Her optimized laser weapon can penetrate to back-row enemies from a longer distance. The devil's horns custom-made to Dreamer's own specifications also emit a jamming signal while in battle, enshrouding herself and her allies in layers of thick, black smoke, turning them into phantoms that spread confusion, chaos, and imminent death... You'd better pray you never encounter her during the night... because no prey survives in an environment where she has the absolute upper hand.

skills.name: Phantom in the Haze
skills.description:
Passive: When Dreamer - Moonlit Sentinel is present, attack range of all ranged echelon members increases by 3.
Active: Fire a penetrating light beam straight ahead, dealing #1 guaranteed damage that scales with Dummy-Links and ignores armor.
If the skill activates while this unit is shrouded by ghostly mist/c the beam attack deals an additional instance of #2 guaranteed damage that ignores armor and penetrates shields to the enemy unit with the highest HP.

skills.name: Ghastly Sting
skills.description:
Fire 3 sniper shots at the farthest enemy target, with each shot taking 1.5 seconds to aim and dealing #1 damage.
If this unit performs her sniper attack while shrouded by ghostly mist, sniper shots are guaranteed to hit and do not require aiming.

skills.name: Hallows' Mania
skills.description:
At the start of the battle, fill the entire battlefield with ghostly mist for 10 seconds (ghost mist lasts throughout night battles).
Accuracy of all units shrouded by ghostly mist is reduced by #1. Enshrouded units also take 10% more damage.
When Dreamer - Moonlit Sentinel is present, ghostly mist does not affect enshrouded allies, but increases their evasion by #2.

skills.name: Nightstalker
skills.description: During night battles, all echelon members' night vision increases by #1 and deal #2 more damage.

units.name: Gray
units.introduce: Gray is a Nyto specialized in support, skilled in utilizing all advantageous factors and aspects of her surroundings in combat. Gray has the ability to precisely skewer a heavily guarded target whilst healing her teammates, gaining an distinct advantage while weakening the enemy. A creation formerly made by Paradeus to replace the human doctor named Gray; the frame was recovered, repaired and then erased of all memories before use, only retaining the creation's combat capabilities as the former "Lady of Ashes" and its subconscious habits as a "Doctor". Although it may just be a soulless mechanical replica now, a scalpel wielded by the righteous can still serve its purpose.

skills.name: Lesion Puncture
skills.description:
Gray will prioritize an enemy target with the highest shield HP, leap up to them, remove their shield and deal #1 damage that scales with dummy links.
#2 of the removed shield HP will then be dealt as damage to the target and all enemy units within an area of 1.5, with damage capped at 10000.

skills.name: CPR
skills.description: Choose any friendly echelons within a range of 1 node. The selected echelon will recover #1 max HP and receive a #2 max HP shield at the start of a battle.

skills.name: Radiotherapy
skills.description:
Significantly enhance allied units at the start of the battle; allies gain an effect where normal attacks will additionally deal 2 instances of #1 damage, lasting for #2 seconds.
After the effect wears off, enhanced units lose HP equivalent to 5% of their max HP.

skills.name: Recurring Barrier
skills.description: While Gray is on the battlefield, all friendly units will receive a HP shield equivalent to #1 of lost max HP every 10 seconds, lasting for #2 seconds.

units.name: Gager - VWV Model
units.introduce: Gager - Seaside Combat Specialist Model, or VWV for short, is a specialized frame modified and optimized for naval combat based on Gager's original frame. If Gager is not near the sea, she will modify the surrounding environment to that of a seaside-like environment using her stored material before commencing combat. The anchor-like weapon allows her to dole out brutal firepower while also providing the ability to summon wind waves.

skills.name: Aegir's Anchor
skills.description:
Passive: Gager - VWV Model's normal attacks deal 2 instances of 0.6x damage, which bypasses shields of any targets inflicted with the Wet status.
Active: Gager - VWV Model will select the highest HP enemy and fire 5 times at it rapidly, each attack dealing #1 damage. Then, Gager will throw her weapon at the enemy target's location, dealing #2 damage that scales with dummy links within an area of 3, and apply the wet status, which lasts 5 seconds.

skills.name: Wild Waves
skills.description: Immediately summon three small torrents with an area of 2, dealing #1 damage that scales with dummy links and apply the Wet status, lasting for #2 seconds. Then, reduce the ROF and accuracy of all enemy units by #3, with this effect being enhanced by 20% for targets affected by Wet status, lasting for #4 seconds.

skills.name: Ebbing Tide
skills.description: Change the battle background to that of a summer beach at the start of battle. Summon a torrent every #1 seconds with an area of 4 to attack enemies, dealing #2 damage that scales with dummy links and apply the Wet status for #3 seconds.

skills.name: Encirclement
skills.description: When Gager - VWV Model is present, increase damage of all units against non Sangvis Ferri faction enemies by #1.

units.name: Beluga
units.introduce: Originally an elite T-Doll created in Persica's lab, she left Griffin and traveled from place to place after being infected by the Parapluie virus, but she never once forgot her mission. M16A1, Leinad Kcaj, ���֧ݧ�ԧ�, Beluga... To her, these are all just code names that represent different phases in her life; she is still her own true self. Her frame may be covered in scars, but her wealth of experience has only made her more sagacious and accomplished, enabling her to take on enemies effortlessly alongside different allies.

skills.name: Shadow of Death
skills.description:
Passive: Each of Beluga's attack has a 20% chance of inflicting a debuff that reduces a random stat by 5% on all enemy units, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 3 seconds.
Active: Summon an airstrike, dealing #1 damage that scales with Dummy-Links to all enemy units, while also reducing their rate of fire, armor, and movement speed by #2 for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Symbiosis
skills.description: When Beluga's echelon is on the map, increase the damage and evasion of present Griffin echelons by #1 and #2 respectively, as well as the critical rate and armor of present Coalition echelons by #3 and #4 respectively.

skills.name: Bird Flight
skills.description:
When Beluga is present on the battlefield, Beak will enter the fray every #1 seconds, charging at the farthest enemy unit and dealing #2 damage that scales with Dummy-Links to all units in her path.
If the target's HP is below 20%, the charge has a 10% chance of dealing fatal damage that is capped at 99999 points. The more stat debuffs there are on the target, the higher the chance of triggering this, capping at 100%.

skills.name: Garrotte
skills.description: Deal #1 more damage to elite units. If there is a boss unit in the current battle, also increase all stats by #2.

units.name: Grig
units.introduce: Calm and perceptive, she is adept at using the longsword and her claws. She can precisely target the moment an opponent exposes themselves and assassinate them with extremely swift movements. For the reawakened "Grig", the person who once held her heart in her hands is gone. Even if someone with her shape still remains in this world, she can never reclaim the bond they used to have. As such, she has chosen to focus on every single attack she makes in the present.

skills.name: Twin Butterfly
skills.description:
Passive: Deals 2 instances of 50% damage to the nearest unit. During night battles, there is a 50% chance that the attack will automatically hit. 
Active: Select the most threatening enemy unit and perform an assassination on it which deals #1 damage to it and applies Terror to all enemy units (damage and attack speed reduced by #2) for #3 seconds. If the target is a boss unit, damage dealt is increased to #4.

skills.name: Cruel Claw
skills.description: Uses claws to deal 6 instances of #1 damage that scales with Dummy-Links within a 4 unit radius and applies the Bleed effect (lose 999 points of HP per seconds) for #2 seconds.

skills.name: Buildup
skills.description: For each elite/high-threat unit in this battle, damage dealt is increased by #1 and damage taken is reduced by #2 points. Stacks up to 10 times.

skills.name: Exuviant Shroud
skills.description: Whenever this unit takes damage, evasion is increased by #1 points. Stacks up to 20 times.

units.name: Brute
units.introduce: Sangvis Ferri's new melee combat unit. It approaches enemies at high speed and deals a fearsome amount of damage, but is only equipped with negligible armor, making it quite fragile.

skills.name: Wrathful Combo
skills.description: A Brute's normal attacks inflict two instances of #1 melee damage. Every #2 seconds, one normal attack reduces enemy armor by #3 of the Brute's AP for #4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

skills.name: Extermination Order
skills.description: When in Destroy and Charge Modes, every attack increases melee damage taken by the target by #1 points, while also increasing evasion by #2. Added damage stacks up to 3 times while evasion increase stacks up to 6 times, lasting for #3 seconds.

units.name: Dragoon
units.introduce: Sangvis Ferri's high-spec combat Dummy equipped with a small-scale transportational mech. It has considerable firepower, firing range, and maneuverability, making it an effective assaulter on the battlefield.

skills.name: Blade Dance
skills.description: When this unit is in Defense Mode, gain 3 attack range. At the start of battle, immediately gain a shield with a value of #1 of its max HP, lasting for #2 seconds. While the shield is in effect, increase damage by #3, rate of fire by #4 and move speed by 50%. These buffs are lost when the shield is broken.

skills.name: Blade Prison
skills.description: Normal attacks reduce enemy units' damage by #1 and accuracy by #2, stacking up to 1 times and lasting for #3 seconds.

units.name: Aegis
units.introduce: The Military's regular combat unit. Outfitted with regular electric weaponry and a military shield, it possesses excellent melee combat capabilities and very sturdy armor.

skills.name: Shield of Holy Light
skills.description: Grants self a #1-point shield which lasts #2 seconds.

skills.name: Fearless Defense
skills.description: Reduce damage taken by #1. When in Defense Mode, reduce damage taken by other units in the same column by #2. Stacks up to 3 times.

units.name: Nemeum
units.introduce: A regular military mech made for the army equipped with the contemporary military firing system. It can charge up to deal higher damage, but has a low rate of fire and poor defense.

skills.name: Mark of Brutality
skills.description: The Nemeum's normal attacks mark the target for #1 seconds. Whenever the Nemeum attacks a marked target, the Nemeum gains #2 critical chance for every mark in effect on it, stacking up to 10 times.

skills.name: Flaying Strike
skills.description: Every normal attack does additional damage equal to #1 of the target's maximum health, to a maximum of 2x of the Nemeum's damage.

units.name: Tarantula
units.introduce: An upgraded version of the Sangvis "Dinergate". With significantly improved survivability, it can close in quickly and deal massive damage to enemies in groups.

skills.name: Reinforcement of the Strong
skills.description: After every #1 normal attacks, reinforce this unit with 1 units that have #2 of this unit's stats for #3 seconds. In addition, for every 1 Tarantula links which are lost, add an additional 1 units with full stats for #4 seconds while also gaining a shield with #5 of a single link's HP for #6 seconds, stacking up to 1 times.

skills.name: Survival Instinct
skills.description: The lower a Tarantula's health, the less damage it takes. For every #1 health it loses, it takes 1% less damage. Tarantulas summoned as reinforcements also have this skill.

units.name: Manticore
units.introduce: A regular military mech made for the army equipped with contemporary military assault weaponry and armor. It deals staggering long-range damage and is extremely well-defended.

skills.name: Vicious Assault
skills.description: The next normal attack is enhanced into a strafing barrage centered on the horizontal row occupied by the current target, inflicting two instances of #1 damage to each targets' Dummy-Link

skills.name: Adaptive Suppression
skills.description: The Manticore suppresses units which have not entered attack mode yet. Units which have been suppressed cannot be suppressed again during the cooldown period. If in Guard mode, the Manticore pushes back enemy units and reduces their movement and attack speed by #1 for #2 seconds. If not in Guard mode, enemies are stunned for #3 seconds.

units.name: Guard_SWAP
units.introduce: An upgraded version of the Guard. Both its shield and short-range weaponry have been enhanced, further improving its already outstanding defensive capabilities.

skills.name: Adaptive Coating
skills.description: Provide all friendly Dolls with a shield with a value of #1 of own HP for 10 seconds. If the targeted unit has no shield, gain an additional #2 evasion. If it does have a shield, gain an additional #3 damage. Both buffs last for #4 seconds.

skills.name: Anti-Ballistic Coating
skills.description: Gain #1 damage reduction for #2 seconds. When this buff expires or is removed, deal #3 guaranteed damage to enemies in front of self.

skills.name: Extreme Adaptation
skills.description: When in Defense Mode, raise self evasion by #1. When not in Defense Mode, raise self damage by #2. These effects last for #3 seconds.

skills.name: Danger Sense
skills.description: This skill triggers every #1 seconds or whenever a Dummy-Link is lost. In Guard Mode, gain a force field for #2 seconds. When not in Guard Mode, raise self firepower by #3 for #4 seconds.

units.name: Vespid_SWAP
units.introduce: A Vespid with greatly improved performance. Debuffs friendly units. Delighted over being issued a new set of helmet and body armor.

skills.name: Group Support
skills.description: Raise all ranged units' rate of fire by #1 and their accuracy by #2 for #3 seconds. Does not stack.

skills.name: Firepower Disruption
skills.description: The enemy unit with the highest HP is attacked first, inflicting a guaranteed critical hit on them while also decreasing their damage by #1, rate of fire by #2 and move speed by #3 for #4 seconds. This effect does not stack. This effect triggers again every 3 attacks.

units.name: Prowler_SWAP
units.introduce: An upgraded version of the Prowler. The weak firepower and low mobility have been compensated, making it fully viable in direct confrontations that involve intense crossfires.

skills.name: Burning Soul Instinct
skills.description: When in Defense Mode, raise the firepower and evasion of units behind itself. If not in Defense Mode, raise the firepower and evasion of all friendly melee units within a radius of 3. Firepower is increased by #1 and evasion is increased by #2, with a maximum of 3 stacks per unit.

skills.name: Protection Emphasis
skills.description: All friendly units gain a #1-point shield. If the target is a melee unit, it gains an additional 2% shield for every 1% of its health it has lost. The shield lasts #2 seconds and stacks up to 3 times.

units.name: Dragoon_SWAP
units.introduce: An upgraded version of the Dragoon. Both the transportational mech and assault weaponry have been enhanced, making its overall improvement the most significant out of all Sangvis units. Confront with caution.

skills.name: Arrester
skills.description: At the start of the battle, gain a shield with a value equal to #1 of max HP. After that, gain a shield with a value of #2 of max HP every #3 seconds and #4 damage intake reduction. The damage intake reduction can stack up to 2 times. While the shield is up, increase self damage by #5, rate of fire by #6 and move speed by #7. If the shield is broken, clear all stacks and jump back, then gain 3 points of attack range and raise self evasion by #8.

skills.name: Blade Prison
skills.description: Normal attacks reduce enemy units' damage by #1 and accuracy by #2, stacking up to 1 times and lasting for #3 seconds.

units.name: Striker_SWAP
units.introduce: An upgraded version of the Striker. With improved firepower and sturdier armor, it deals more damage and is more effective in suppressing enemy fire.

skills.name: Assault Order
skills.description: At the start of battle, each attack does #1 additional damage for #2 seconds.

skills.name: Deconstruction Command
skills.description: Every 4 attacks, deal additional damage that scales with Dummy-Links to armored enemies. The damage equals #1 the difference between self's armor penetration and the enemies' armor values, with the difference being no smaller than 1.

units.name: Aegis_SWAP
units.introduce: An upgraded version of the Military Aegis hacked by Sangvis Ferri. Outfitted with contemporary high-spec military armor and a reinforced shield, its melee combat capabilities also see a devastating improvement.

skills.name: Shield of Holy Light
skills.description: Grants self a #1-point shield which lasts #2 seconds.

skills.name: Forcefield Concentration
skills.description: The more Dummies this character has, the less damage it takes. Each Dummy provides #1 damage intake reduction. If a shield is present, damage taken cannot exceed the shield value.

units.name: Jaeger SWAP
units.introduce: An upgraded version of Jaeger. The long-range sniping weapon is enhanced in terms of firepower and accuracy, and the unit itself is no longer as fragile as it used to be, making it a more formidable enemy.

skills.name: Owlbear Strike
skills.description: After every #1 normal attacks, take aim for 1 seconds before firing a shot at the furthest enemy unit, dealing #2 damage which always hits and ignores armor.

skills.name: Weak Spot Marking
skills.description: When the current target is suffering from negative status effects, Jaeger SWAPs deal #1 additional damage to the target.

units.name: Gingerbread Guard
units.introduce: A high-tier Sangvis holiday unit equipped with a gingerbread shield and candy cane. As its appearance suggests, it is very sugary. It is mostly used to defend the very important kitchen or to intercept Dreamer, who slips in to steal candy while using Destroyer as a diversion.

skills.name: Adaptive Coating
skills.description: Provide all friendly Dolls with a shield with a value of #1 of own HP for 10 seconds. If the targeted unit has no shield, gain an additional #2 evasion. If it does have a shield, gain an additional #3 damage. Both buffs last for #4 seconds.

skills.name: Frost Coating
skills.description: Decreases damage of all enemies within a 3 radius by #1. Enemies on the field with Chilling Marks or Frozen Marks additionally gain #2 vulnerability. This lasts 6 seconds and can stack up to 2 times.

units.name: Zombie Bride
units.introduce: Resentment clad in gorgeous silk endlessly roams the corridors of the silent mansion. Don't be deceived by her beautiful appearance; if she throws the bouquet she's holding at you, make sure to duck.

skills.name: Group Support
skills.description: Raise all ranged units' rate of fire by #1 and their accuracy by #2 for #3 seconds. Does not stack.

skills.name: Waking Incense
skills.description: All allies no longer gain Rose Marks. At the start of battle, increases all allies' damage and critical damage by #1. This effect does not stack.

units.name: Jaws Paradise
units.introduce: An illegal weapon disguised as a shark themed park for ease of smuggling. It's main purpose is to mass produce Shark Volleyballs, but its adorable appearance has made it quite popular among children while it is being transported.

skills.name: Shark Serve!
skills.description:
After the battle begins, spawn Shark Volleyball reinforcements onto the battlefield at a rate determined by self attack speed. Each Shark Volleyball has 10 points of move speed and inherits #1 of the Jaws Paradise's HP and 10% of its damage, with all other stats being the same as the main unit.
Shark Volleyballs that make contact with an enemy or which reach their maximum range immediately self-destruct and deal #2 explosive damage to all units within a 3-unit radius, while also applying #3 vulnerability to them for 3 seconds.
In Defend and Charge Modes, Shark Volleyballs will travel forward in a straight line until they hit an enemy unit; in Destroy Mode, Shark Volleyballs will seek out the nearest unit and trigger their damage.

skills.name: Random Pass!
skills.description:
Every #1 spawns of Shark Volleyballs has a chance to additionally spawn a Blue Shark Volleyball or a Yellow Shark Volleyball.
Blue Shark Volleyball: Move to the allied unit with the lowest HP percentage and grant a #2-point shield to all friendly units within a 3-unit radius for 5 seconds. Units shielded in this way gain #3 points of evasion while the shield exists. Alina – Mosasaur Rider gains double the effect.
Yellow Shark Volleyball: Move to the enemy unit with the highest DPS and stun all enemy units within a 1-unit radius for 2 seconds. If Alina – Mosasaur Rider is present, stun them for 4 seconds instead.

units.name: Ripper
units.introduce: Sangvis Ferri's regular combat Dummy equipped with short-range assault weaponry. Its high mobility often puts it in the role of a vanguard or a scout.

skills.name: Extreme Adaptation
skills.description: When in Defense Mode, raise self evasion by #1. When not in Defense Mode, raise self damage by #2. These effects last for #3 seconds.

units.name: Vespid
units.introduce: Sangvis Ferri's regular combat Dummy equipped with long-range assault weaponry. Its firepower is about the same as a low-tier Military unit. It makes up the main force in small-scale skirmishes.

skills.name: Group Support
skills.description: Raise all ranged units' rate of fire by #1 and their accuracy by #2 for #3 seconds. Does not stack.

units.name: Guard
units.introduce: Sangvis Ferri's high-spec combat Dummy equipped with a shield and short-range weaponry. As its appearance suggests, it has high defensive capabilities and is often used to defend important units or to enter the fray as a more advanced vanguard.

skills.name: Protective Layer
skills.description: When in Defense Mode, grant a #1-point shield to all friendly Doll units in the same column. When not in Defense Mode, grant a #2-point shield to all friendly Doll units within a radius of 3, stacking up to 3 times and lasting for #3 seconds.

units.name: Jaeger
units.introduce: Sangvis Ferri's regular combat Dummy equipped with long-range sniping weaponry. Deals heavy damage and has high accuracy, but is physically fragile. An enemy to watch out for on the battlefield.

skills.name: Owlbear Strike
skills.description: After every #1 normal attacks, take aim for 1 seconds before firing a shot at the furthest enemy unit, dealing #2 damage which always hits and ignores armor.

units.name: Striker
units.introduce: Sangvis Ferri's regular combat unit equipped with a long-range machine gun. Possesses high firepower and rate of fire, making it the main damage dealers and suppressors on the field.

skills.name: Assault Order
skills.description: At the start of battle, each attack does #1 additional damage for #2 seconds.

units.name: Dinergate
units.introduce: Sangvis Ferri's low-spec combat mech. It has mediocre combat capabilities but is suited for mass production. Usually used in defensive or search missions. Attacks by ramming with force; not to be underestimated in groups.

skills.name: Reinforcement of the Meek
skills.description: After every #1 normal attacks, reinforce this unit with 1 units that have #2 of this unit's stats for #3 seconds. In addition, for every 1 Dinergate links which are lost, add an additional 1 units with full stats for #4 seconds while also gaining a shield with #5 of self HP for #6 seconds, stacking up to 1 times.

units.name: Scout
units.introduce: Sangvis Ferri's low-spec combat mech. It has mediocre combat capabilities but is highly mobile and good at concealment. Often used in frontline reconnaissance.

skills.name: Weak Spot Marking
skills.description: Marks enemy units within a radius of 2 from the current target. Marked units have their evasion lowered by #1. When friendly units damage a marked unit, they deal an additional #2 points of damage. The effect lasts #3 seconds and stacks up to 1 times.

units.name: Prowler
units.introduce: Sangvis Ferri's low-spec combat mech. It has poor firepower and mobility. Primarily used to patrol their own lines and conduct reconnaissance.

skills.name: Burning Soul Instinct
skills.description: When in Defense Mode, raise the firepower and evasion of units behind itself. If not in Defense Mode, raise the firepower and evasion of all friendly melee units within a radius of 3. Firepower is increased by #1 and evasion is increased by #2, with a maximum of 3 stacks per unit.

units.name: Jaguar
units.introduce: Sangvis Ferri's regular combat mech. A mobile mortar that deals high damage. Its maneuverability is poor, but its firepower is comparable to that of contemporary Military weapons.

skills.name: Accurate Calibration
skills.description: Every attack by the Jaguar deals #1 explosive damage to all enemy units within a radius of 2 units.

units.name: Goliath Factory
units.introduce: A mobile Sangvis weapon factory that can keep churning out self-detonating Goliaths. The longer it remains on the battlefield, the more threatening it is.

skills.name: Clearance Protocol
skills.description:
Default: Once the battle starts, continuously produce Goliath reinforcements at a rate dependent on self attack speed. Each Goliath has 10 points of move speed and inherits #1 of the Goliath Factory's HP and 10% of its damage. All other stats are the same as the main unit.
Upon contact with the enemy or upon reaching their maximum range, Goliaths immediately self-destruct, dealing #2 explosive damage to all enemies within a radius of 3 units. In Defense and Charge Modes, Goliaths will move forward until they come into contact with an enemy; in Destroy Mode they will seek out the closest enemy unit.
